view_definitions.dw_intermediate.int_invoice_header:
SELECT stg_sales_invoices.invoice_id AS source_invoice_id,
    stg_sales_invoices.order_id AS source_order_id,
    stg_sales_invoices.invoice_date,
    (to_char((stg_sales_invoices.invoice_date)::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMMDD'::text))::integer AS invoice_date_key,
    stg_sales_invoices.customer_id AS source_buyer_customer_id,
    stg_sales_invoices.bill_to_customer_id AS source_bill_to_customer_id,
    md5(((('CUSTOMER:OBSERVED_CAPTURE:'::text || ('c825b18e-fc62-4cf1-8837-b37b4c9f9668'::uuid)::text) || ':'::text) || (stg_sales_invoices.customer_id)::text)) AS buyer_observed_customer_key,
    md5(((('CUSTOMER:OBSERVED_CAPTURE:'::text || ('c825b18e-fc62-4cf1-8837-b37b4c9f9668'::uuid)::text) || ':'::text) || (stg_sales_invoices.bill_to_customer_id)::text)) AS bill_to_observed_customer_key,
    NULL::text AS buyer_customer_key,
    NULL::text AS bill_to_customer_key,
    'U'::text AS buyer_lookup_status,
    'U'::text AS bill_to_lookup_status,
    'HISTORICAL_SCD2_DEFERRED'::text AS historical_lookup_reason,
    stg_sales_invoices.is_credit_note,
    stg_sales_invoices.confirmed_delivery_time,
    stg_sales_invoices._capture_id,
    stg_sales_invoices.record_identity,
    stg_sales_invoices.source_object,
    stg_sales_invoices.source_business_key,
    stg_sales_invoices._raw_row_ordinal,
    stg_sales_invoices.ruleset_version,
    stg_sales_invoices.evaluation_id,
    '86ac5adfd16901e62f9d100ba567b9e60bca60b9ead94c54ddcb3ecddfc69e91'::text AS measure_version,
    q.dq_status,
    q.is_valid,
    q.has_warning,
    q.is_quarantined,
    q.is_valid AS is_sales_eligible
   FROM (dw_staging.stg_sales_invoices
     JOIN dq.record_status q USING (record_identity, ruleset_version, evaluation_id, source_object, source_business_key, _raw_row_ordinal));
view_definitions.dw_intermediate.int_order_header:
SELECT stg_sales_orders.order_id AS source_order_id,
    stg_sales_orders.order_date,
    (to_char((stg_sales_orders.order_date)::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMMDD'::text))::integer AS order_date_key,
    stg_sales_orders.customer_id AS source_buyer_customer_id,
    md5(((('CUSTOMER:OBSERVED_CAPTURE:'::text || ('c825b18e-fc62-4cf1-8837-b37b4c9f9668'::uuid)::text) || ':'::text) || (stg_sales_orders.customer_id)::text)) AS buyer_observed_customer_key,
    NULL::text AS buyer_customer_key,
    'U'::text AS buyer_lookup_status,
    'HISTORICAL_SCD2_DEFERRED'::text AS buyer_lookup_reason,
    stg_sales_orders._capture_id,
    stg_sales_orders.record_identity,
    stg_sales_orders.source_object,
    stg_sales_orders.source_business_key,
    stg_sales_orders._raw_row_ordinal,
    stg_sales_orders.ruleset_version,
    stg_sales_orders.evaluation_id,
    '86ac5adfd16901e62f9d100ba567b9e60bca60b9ead94c54ddcb3ecddfc69e91'::text AS measure_version,
    q.dq_status,
    q.is_valid,
    q.has_warning,
    q.is_quarantined,
    q.is_valid AS is_order_eligible
   FROM (dw_staging.stg_sales_orders
     JOIN dq.record_status q USING (record_identity, ruleset_version, evaluation_id, source_object, source_business_key, _raw_row_ordinal));

preservation.method: Fresh read-only transactions before/after; tuple multiset MD5, rows; runtime advisory locks held; no mutation statements
